line_sources.api: The Odds API free plan, one snapshot a day
line_sources.manual: typed from the owner's own account

snapshot.scope: games whose commence_time is after the snapshot; games already started are out of scope and counted

eligibility.why: pre-game proxy for the training population (min10): at a 15-minute floor 95.7% of the proxy rows are min10 and 86.3% of min10 rows are kept; 98.2% of min10 rows have inputs at most 10 days old (reports/ledger_rule_evidence_2025-26.json)

edge.why: the edge constants already pre-registered per target on the training population (reports/policy_2025-26.json populations.min10.targets.<target>.threshold)

stake.risked: one unit risked per bet, every bet
stake.profit_on_win: from the captured American price on the bet side

settlement.pending: the game's box score is absent from the stored logs
settlement.won: actual on the bet side of the line
settlement.lost: actual on the other side of the line
settlement.push: actual equals the line (whole-number lines only)
settlement.void: the game's box score is present and the player has no row in it (did not play); a row with any minutes played, even under one, means the action stands

rule.side_bias: the model is a LightGBM regressor trained on squared error (a conditional mean); a book's line sits near the median and points are right-skewed, so the rule may lean to overs; not adjusted for, reported by side in mart_ledger_by_side

reading.then: show the 95% interval and the break-even rate implied by the actual prices; a verdict only when the interval excludes break-even
reading.power_note: separating a 55% hit rate from the 52.4% break-even of -110 takes about 1,400 settled bets: n = (1.96 * sqrt(0.55 * 0.45) / (0.55 - 0.524))^2 = 1,406

rule.headline: source api only; manual lines never enter the headline numbers
rule.reporting: in-sample (2025-26 replay) and out-of-sample (2026-27 ledger) are labelled and never pooled; no profitability claim without n and a confidence interval
